This is Crate. An AI sampler, built for the iPhone Duo.
Type a vibe. Dilla drums, Nujabes piano.
It digs through your own samples instantly, and the AI writes the arrangement.
Flip to keys, and the sample becomes an instrument.
Turn on AI Perform, and it plays fills with you, bar by bar.
And here's the fun part. The hinge is the effects knob. Fold it down to build the tension...
And the back screen drops with you.
Crate. Type a vibe, get a beat.
